data:
Decision: NO-GO. Win probability: 8.9%.

Top probability drivers: (1) Low expected evaluation score (est. 69.3) is the dominant negative—likely non-competitive technical/overall scoring versus peers. (2) Budget size (PKR 85M; log 4.454) slightly reduces attractiveness/fit for our cost-to-bid and margin profile. (3) Limited response time (240 hrs) marginally increases execution risk and depresses quality of submission.

Mandatory gaps and what closing them takes: One mandatory compliance gap—“All active equipment from a single OEM” plus “valid partner/reseller authorisation.” To close: select one OEM across all active components (LAN/WAN/security/DC as applicable), secure official OEM authorisation letter for this tender (validity, scope, territory), align BOM and architecture to that OEM, and update compliance matrix. Also convert 3 PARTIAL items to PASS to raise coverage beyond 80.8%.

Recommendation: Stay NO-GO unless OEM single-vendor strategy and authorisation can be confirmed immediately and we can materially lift the expected score.
